verdict: DO NOT ORDER: full turnkey manufacturing is NOT confirmed
audit_scope: Design-file, public supplier capability, catalog stock/pricing, critical footprint/stencil, native geometry and release-document audit. Not supplier CAM/DFM acceptance, complete manufacturer land-pattern certification, placement model approval, physical fit testing or powered qualification.

issues.Finding: Native dielectric stack and 70 um internal copper differ from JLC081622-1080: 1.655 mm finished target and 61 um inner copper. A thickness dropdown is not an approved construction.
issues.Required_closure: Select an approved stack; update native construction and magnetic/copper-loss model, check core/clip tolerances and validate the transformer. Do not silently substitute the candidate.

issues.Finding: U5 pad 5 and C26 pad 1 overlap on V5. Same-net copper does not trigger normal electrical clearance DRC. The two components have connected paste/mask regions.
issues.Required_closure: Separate the lands and paste regions, reroute the local bypass connection, then recheck actual body/pad clearances and soldering access.

issues.Finding: U1 pad pairs 1-2 and 10-11 measure about 0.194 mm, below the published 0.20 mm 2 oz pad-spacing threshold for mask bridges. Imported custom polygons carry a 0.10 mm stroke. Power/thermal paste is full area rather than TI segmented examples.
issues.Required_closure: Rebuild and independently review U1 copper, separate mask and paste from TI RAR0017B; obtain a manufacturable 2 oz stencil/mask process. Do not blindly shrink the power lands or remove mask dams. TI example: 75% coverage on 5/6/7 and 76% on 17 with 0.125 mm stencil.

issues.Finding: 14 purchased footprints have copper pads extending beyond their courtyards. Existing zero courtyard overlaps therefore do not demonstrate adequate assembly clearance. Several component pad gaps are below JLC recommended spacing.
issues.Required_closure: Correct courtyards to cover maximum body and solder lands with assembly allowance; inspect all 75 placements. Preserve short GaN loops through specific factory approval where spacing recommendations conflict.

issues.Finding: U1 land coordinates are shifted about +0.625 mm in local Y relative to the TI package center; exported CPL is at the footprint anchor. All 13 polarized U/D/Q footprints have no top-silk graphics. Raw rotations are not calibrated to JLC part models.
issues.Required_closure: Resolve package centers and rotations against actual supplier placement models; add visible, unambiguous pin-1/cathode markers and approve a per-part placement overlay. Use pad coordinates in Assembly-pad-map.csv as independent evidence.

issues.Finding: 64 x 56 mm outline is below Standard PCBA single/panel 70 x 70 mm minimum. Handling rails are absent, while headers overhang opposite sides. The four 1.6 mm contact holes require an approved THT solder operation.
issues.Required_closure: Factory-design and approve a routed handling panel with rails, tooling and fiducials; preserve original board outline/mounts. A roughly 90 x 76 mm one-up frame is only a planning envelope, not fabrication data. Approve lead protrusion, pallet access and depanelization before core fitting.

issues.Finding: Two core halves and two clips per unit are separate DigiKey purchases; JLC installation is not accepted. Mating plugs are external and omitted from PCB BOM/CPL.
issues.Required_closure: Obtain written acceptance and price for sourcing/consignment, post-solder core/clip fitting and any plug-fitting operation. Loose accessory shipment is not standard PCBA scope. Otherwise the delivery is electronics-only PCBA plus separately procured mechanical/accessory parts.

issues.Finding: 150 routed vias intersect purchased SMT lands. All 221 small interconnect drills must be filled/capped, including six T1 transitions exported as plated pads; four connector holes and four mounting holes must stay open.
issues.Required_closure: Specify resin fill, copper cap and planarization by drill tool and location. Obtain CAM confirmation for T1 pads, appropriate paste engineering, solder profile and X-ray inspection of hidden joints.

issues.Finding: 18 front printed labels are 0.8-0.9 mm high versus the supplier 1 mm guidance. Some polarity text is close to the connector body.
issues.Required_closure: Enlarge/reposition legend and add polarity marks without covering mask openings or allowing assembly to hide essential orientation. Check final Gerber, not only a 3D render.

issues.Finding: 43 exact electronic catalog matches, all with enough snapshot stock for five fitted boards. Lowest stocks: F1 28 and L2 39. Assembly attrition and warehouse/order allocation are unconfirmed.
issues.Required_closure: Refresh order-specific stock and excess quantities before payment; no substitutions without engineering review. Reserve or pre-order critical parts only after design release.

issues.Finding: The existing ratings audit still holds magnetics loss, MLCC effective capacitance/ripple, surge margin and frequency-dependent overcurrent protection. Hardware has not been powered.
issues.Required_closure: Resolve design limits and perform controlled engineering bring-up. Only then freeze measurable functional-test limits and supplier test procedure. AOI and bare-board flying probe are not a 60 W acceptance test.

issues.Finding: Nominal core openings are 17.1 x 6.1 mm and 17.1 x 5.4 mm, with 0.5 mm corner radii. Core tolerances, corner geometry, clips, standoffs and assembled height are not fully tolerance-qualified.
issues.Required_closure: Approve a mechanical fit trial with the actual core and clips, the chosen finished stack, routed-slot tolerance and underside clearance. No ferrite grinding or extra gap spacer.
